description: Baby Lalibela lying in a crib. A swarm of bees hovers gently around him, symbolizing his future greatness. His mother looks on in wonder.
text_content: In the hidden mountains of Ethiopia, a King was born. His name was Lalibela. Legend says bees surrounded him as a baby!

description: King Lalibela standing on a mountain ridge, looking towards the horizon with a longing expression. The terrain is rugged and dry.
text_content: Lalibela grew up to be a very holy King. He wanted his people to see the holy city of Jerusalem, but the journey was too dangerous.

description: King Lalibela asleep, having a vision. Angels are showing him blueprints of churches descending from heaven.
text_content: So, Lalibela had a dream. He would build a New Jerusalem right here in Ethiopia. But he wouldn't build it *up*.

description: Workers standing on top of a flat rock surface, chiseling downwards. A trench is beginning to form. Dust flies in the air.
text_content: He commanded his workers to carve the churches *down* into the solid red rock! They used hammers and chisels.

description: A night scene. The site is deserted of humans, but glowing, transparent angels are continuing the carving work on the stone.
text_content: It was hard work. But stories say that while the men worked by day, the angels worked by night to help them.

description: A stunning high-angle shot looking down into the cruciform (cross-shaped) pit of the Church of St. George (Bet Giyorgis). The red rock contrasts with the green moss.
text_content: They carved eleven amazing churches. The most famous one is shaped like a perfect cross. It is called St. George's.

description: Interior of a rock-hewn church. Light beams stream through cross-shaped windows. A priest is reading a Bible near a pillar.
text_content: Inside, the churches are hollowed out, with columns and windows. It feels like standing inside a mountain.

description: A pilgrim walking through a narrow, high-walled stone trench connecting the churches. The sky is a strip of blue above.
text_content: Connecting the churches are deep tunnels and trenches. It is like a secret maze dedicated to God.

description: Medieval European mapmakers discussing a map. They point to a mythical figure of a King labeled 'Prester John' in Africa.
text_content: Europeans heard rumors of a powerful Christian King in Africa named 'Prester John'. They searched for him everywhere.

description: A meeting between Portuguese explorers and an Ethiopian Emperor. Both look regal. They are exchanging gifts.
text_content: They didn't find Prester John, but they found the faithful kings of Ethiopia, keeping the flame of Jesus alive.

description: A wide shot of the Lalibela complex at dawn. Pilgrims draped in white shamma cloth are gathering for prayer.
text_content: King Lalibela’s churches still stand today. They are a miracle in stone.

description: A parchment map of the Ethiopian highlands. It marks 'Lalibela'. A small illustration of a cross-shaped church is on the map.
text_content: Map: The Hidden City. This map shows the highlands of Lasta. It marks the 'New Jerusalem' of Lalibela.
